text: Curdled skim milk gives the casein; slaked lime dissolves it into a binder. Use soon after mixing.

sources.text: The table, the facts and the words on how it is made, from these.

steps.note: One gallon of nonfat milk is left warm for a few days to curdle.
The curd is drained through a sieve, and about 2 cups of it are kept.

steps.name: dissolve
steps.note: The curds are put into a solution of 2½ oz slaked lime in 2½ cups of water.
